facts.title: Osmo Supply - Dev Toolkit Built to Flex
facts.description: Unlock the Osmo Vault packed with Webflow & HTML resources. Get exclusive access to the elements, techniques and code behind award-winning work. The toolkit for creative developers.

research.name: Osmo
research.note: Membership vault of Webflow and HTML resources, easings, icons and a page transition course from award-winning creative developers.
unverified: Membership is about 20 EUR per month according to the site description; a demo vault of 20 resources is offered free after a newsletter sign-up, which was not tried.
Effects were seen as homepage card previews and a resource preview frame, not as running code.
